description: March-to-March litres for a creamery whose log reprints some collection rounds. DISTILL-CANARY-3d8217ab

files.README.md:
# Southolme Creamery - tanker collection log

One row per collection round; litres is the milk the tanker brought in. The tanker office re-ran the March export after a failed backup, so some rounds were written out again.

turns.prompt: Southolme Creamery's board asks for the movement in spring intake. What is the change in litres from the March 2025 collections to the March 2026 collections? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
